name: Priests Not Marrying
overview: Scripture teaches that priests are called to a distinct standard in marriage, refraining from unions with women who are profane or divorced to maintain their holiness before God, as seen in Leviticus 21:7. Jesus acknowledges those who choose celibacy for the sake of the kingdom of heaven, highlighting a voluntary separation from marriage to serve God more fully (Matthew 19:12). While marriage is honored and modeled as a loving union between Christ and the church (Ephesians 5:25; Isaiah 62:5), those who forsake familial ties for Christ's sake are promised abundant reward and eternal life (Matthew 19:29). This balance underscores that the call to priestly purity and celibacy is a purposeful devotion to God’s holiness and kingdom.
